---
title: "Which exercise and how much? Comparative effectiveness and dose–response of exercise interventions in institutionalized older adults: A systematic review and Bayesian network meta-analysis"

---


## 0_Libraries 

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ggthemes)
library(tidybayes)
library(brms)
library(marginaleffects)
library(ggsci)
library(multinma)
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
library(splines)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

```

## 0_Import the dataset

```{r}
data <- read_xlsx(path = "YOUR PATH",
                  col_names = TRUE, na = "")
```

## 0_data clean

```{r} 
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    scale = stringr::str_trim(scale),
    outcome = stringr::str_trim(outcome),
    agent = stringr::str_trim(agent),
    trt = stringr::str_trim(trt)
  )
```


## PHYSICAL FUNCTION
### GAIT SPEED # Lower is better = FALSE
## 1_filter domain 

```{r} 
pf_vmarcha <- data %>%
  filter(
    outcome == "physical function",
    scale %in% c("10MWT(m/s)", "6_m_walk(m/s)", "Gait4", "Gait_pref") 
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    y = as.numeric(y),
    se = as.numeric(se),
    postn = as.numeric(postn),
    premean = as.numeric(premean),
    weekly_dose = as.numeric(weekly_dose)
  )
```


## 2_Cheking networks and models

```{r} 
pf_vmarcha %>%
  count(studyID, scale, agent, trt)

pf_vmarcha %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_studies = n_distinct(studyID),
    n_scales = n_distinct(scale),
    n_agents = n_distinct(agent),
    missing_y = sum(is.na(y)),
    missing_se = sum(is.na(se)),
    missing_postn = sum(is.na(postn)),
    missing_premean = sum(is.na(premean))
  )

unique(pf_vmarcha$scale)
unique(pf_vmarcha$agent)
unique(pf_vmarcha$trt)

pf_vmarcha %>%
  count(studyID) %>%
  arrange(n)

```

### Meta-Analysis Model For Agent

## 3_Creation red_Agent

```{r}
mean_premean_vmarcha <- mean(pf_vmarcha$premean, na.rm = TRUE)

pf_vmarcha <- pf_vmarcha %>%
  mutate(premean_c = premean - mean_premean_vmarcha)


net_agent <- set_agd_arm(
  pf_vmarcha,
  study = studyID,
  trt = agent,
  y = y,
  se = se,
  sample_size = postn,
  trt_ref = "usual care"
)

net_agent
plot(net_agent, weight_edges = TRUE, weight_nodes = TRUE)  

plot(net_agent, weight_edges = TRUE, weight_nodes = TRUE) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")


```

## 4_Model 1: Fixed-effect meta-analysis (no covariate)

```{r}
fit_FE_vmarcha_agent <- nma(
  net_agent,
  seed = 25062026,
  trt_effects = "fixed",
  prior_intercept = normal(scale = 1),
  prior_trt = normal(scale = 1)
)

fit_FE_vmarcha_agent

```

## 5_Model 2: Random-effects model (no covariate)

```{r}

fit_RE_vmarcha_agent <- nma(
  net_agent,
  seed = 25062026,
  trt_effects = "random",
  prior_intercept = normal(scale = 1),
  prior_trt = normal(scale = 1),
  prior_het = half_normal(scale = 0.5)
)

fit_RE_vmarcha_agent

```

## 6_Model 3:Fixed-effect meta-analysis with covariate `premean`

```{r}
fit_FE_reg_vmarcha_agent <- nma(
  net_agent,
  seed = 25062026,
  trt_effects = "fixed",
  regression = ~ .trt:premean_c,
  prior_intercept = normal(scale = 1),
  prior_trt = normal(scale = 1),
  prior_reg = normal(scale = 1),
  adapt_delta = 0.99
)

fit_FE_reg_vmarcha_agent


```

## 7_Model 4:Random-effects meta-analysis with covariate `premean`

```{r}
fit_RE_reg_vmarcha_agent <- nma(
  net_agent,
  seed = 25062026,
  trt_effects = "random",
  regression = ~ .trt:premean_c,
  prior_intercept = normal(scale = 1),
  prior_trt = normal(scale = 1),
  prior_reg = normal(scale = 1),
  prior_het = half_normal(scale = 0.5),
  adapt_delta = 0.99
)

fit_RE_reg_vmarcha_agent

```

## 8_Model comparation

```{r}

dic_FE_vmarcha <- dic(fit_FE_vmarcha_agent)
dic_RE_vmarcha <- dic(fit_RE_vmarcha_agent)
dic_FE_reg_vmarcha <- dic(fit_FE_reg_vmarcha_agent)
dic_RE_reg_vmarcha <- dic(fit_RE_reg_vmarcha_agent)

dic_FE_vmarcha
dic_RE_vmarcha
dic_FE_reg_vmarcha
dic_RE_reg_vmarcha

model_comparison_vmarcha <- tibble(
  model = c(
    "Fixed-effect",
    "Random-effects",
    "Fixed-effect + premean",
    "Random-effects + premean"
  ),
  DIC = c(
    dic_FE_vmarcha$dic,
    dic_RE_vmarcha$dic,
    dic_FE_reg_vmarcha$dic,
    dic_RE_reg_vmarcha$dic
  ),
  residual_deviance = c(
    dic_FE_vmarcha$resdev,
    dic_RE_vmarcha$resdev,
    dic_FE_reg_vmarcha$resdev,
    dic_RE_reg_vmarcha$resdev
  )
)

model_comparison_vmarcha


```

## 9_check

```{r}
plot(dic_FE_vmarcha)
plot(dic_RE_vmarcha)
plot(dic_FE_reg_vmarcha)
plot(dic_RE_reg_vmarcha)

```


## 10_model choose

```{r}
fit_main_vmarcha_agent <- fit_RE_reg_vmarcha_agent 
dic_main_vmarcha_agent <- dic_RE_reg_vmarcha

```


## 11_relative effects

```{r}
pf_vmarcha %>%
  summarise(
    min_premean = min(premean, na.rm = TRUE),

  )


rel_effect_vmarcha_agent <- relative_effects(
  fit_main_vmarcha_agent,
  trt_ref = "usual care",
  newdata = tibble(
    studyID = "Mean baseline gait speed",
    premean_c = 0
  ),
  study = studyID
)

rel_effect_vmarcha_agent

plot(rel_effect_vmarcha_agent, ref_line = 0, stat = "halfeye")



summary(fit_main_vmarcha_agent) 
rel_effect_vmarcha_agent


```

```{r}
rank_vmarcha_agent

rank_vmarcha_agent
```

## 17_Checking for inconsistency

```{r}

fit_UME_RE_reg_vmarcha_agent <- nma(
  net_agent,
  seed = 25062026,
  trt_effects = "random",
  regression = ~ .trt:premean_c,
  consistency = "ume",
  prior_intercept = normal(scale = 1),
  prior_trt = normal(scale = 1),
  prior_reg = normal(scale = 1),
  prior_het = half_normal(scale = 0.5),
  adapt_delta = 0.99
)

fit_UME_RE_reg_vmarcha_agent
summary(fit_UME_RE_reg_vmarcha_agent)

dic_UME_RE_reg_vmarcha_agent <- dic(fit_UME_RE_reg_vmarcha_agent)

dic_main_vmarcha_agent
dic_UME_RE_reg_vmarcha_agent

inconsistency_comparison_vmarcha_agent <- tibble(
  model = c(
    "Consistency: random-effects + premean_c",
    "UME: random-effects + premean_c"
  ),
  DIC = c(
    dic_main_vmarcha_agent$dic,
    dic_UME_RE_reg_vmarcha_agent$dic
  ),
  residual_deviance = c(
    dic_main_vmarcha_agent$resdev,
    dic_UME_RE_reg_vmarcha_agent$resdev
  )
)

inconsistency_comparison_vmarcha_agent

plot(
  dic_main_vmarcha_agent,
  dic_UME_RE_reg_vmarcha_agent,
  show_uncertainty = FALSE
)


```

```{r}
rel_effect_pred_vmarcha_agent

prob_harm_vmarcha_agent
```

### Meta-Analysis Model For Trt

## 21_Creation red_Trt

```{r}

mean_premean_vmarcha <- mean(pf_vmarcha$premean, na.rm = TRUE)

pf_vmarcha <- pf_vmarcha %>%
  mutate(
    premean_c = premean - mean_premean_vmarcha)


pf_vmarcha <- pf_vmarcha %>%
  mutate(
    trt = case_when(
      trt == "Tai Chi" ~ "mind body",
      trt == "Yoga" ~ "mind body",
      trt == "theraband" ~ "resistance training",
      trt == "dance" ~ "aerobic",
      trt == "mix aerobic" ~ "aerobic",
      trt ==  "virtual reality" ~ "exergame",
      trt ==  "aerobic+resistance+stretching" ~ "aerobic+resistance",
      TRUE ~ trt
    )
  )

net_trt <- set_agd_arm(
  pf_vmarcha,
  study = studyID,
  trt = trt,
  y = y,
  se = se,
  sample_size = postn,
  trt_ref = "usual care"
)

net_trt
summary(net_trt)

pf_vmarcha %>%
  count(trt, sort = TRUE)

plot(net_trt, weight_edges = TRUE, weight_nodes = TRUE) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")


```

```{r}
fit_FE_vmarcha <- nma(
```

### dose response overall 

## 39_checking data

```{r}
## 39_checking data

pf_vmarcha_overall <- data %>%
  filter(
    outcome == "physical function",
    scale %in% c("10MWT(m/s)", "6_m_walk(m/s)", "Gait4", "Gait_pref")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    y = as.numeric(y),
    se = as.numeric(se),
    postn = as.numeric(postn),
    premean = as.numeric(premean),
    weekly_dose = as.numeric(weekly_dose)
  )



pf_vmarcha_overall %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_studies = n_distinct(studyID),
    missing_weekly_dose = sum(is.na(weekly_dose)),
    missing_y = sum(is.na(y)),
    missing_se = sum(is.na(se)),
    missing_postn = sum(is.na(postn)),
    min_dose = min(weekly_dose, na.rm = TRUE),
    p25_dose = quantile(weekly_dose, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_dose = median(weekly_dose, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dose = mean(weekly_dose, na.rm = TRUE),
    p75_dose = quantile(weekly_dose, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_dose = max(weekly_dose, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_unique_dose = n_distinct(weekly_dose, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


pf_vmarcha_overall %>%
  filter(agent == "usual care") %>%
  summarise(
    n_usual_care = n(),
    n_dose_zero = sum(weekly_dose == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_dose_missing = sum(is.na(weekly_dose))
  )


pf_vmarcha_overall %>%
  filter(agent != "usual care") %>%
  summarise(
    missing_weekly_dose_exercise = sum(is.na(weekly_dose)),
    min_exercise_dose = min(weekly_dose, na.rm = TRUE),
    p25_exercise_dose = quantile(weekly_dose, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_exercise_dose = median(weekly_dose, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_exercise_dose = mean(weekly_dose, na.rm = TRUE),
    p75_exercise_dose = quantile(weekly_dose, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_exercise_dose = max(weekly_dose, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


pf_vmarcha_overall <- pf_vmarcha_overall %>%
  mutate(
    overall = if_else(
      agent == "usual care",
      "usual care",
      "exercise"
    )
  )


pf_vmarcha_overall %>%
  count(overall)


```

## 40_exploratory graph overall

```{r}
## 40_exploratory graph overall

if (!all(c("weekly_dose", "y", "overall") %in% names(pf_vmarcha_overall))) {
  stop(
    "`pf_vmarcha_overall` no colums: ",
    "'weekly_dose', 'y' y 'overall'"
  )
}


pf_vmarcha_overall_dose <- pf_vmarcha_overall %>%
  filter(
    overall == "exercise",
    !is.na(weekly_dose),
    !is.na(y)
  )

lin_plot_vmarcha <- ggplot(
  pf_vmarcha_overall_dose,
  aes(x = weekly_dose, y = y)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "red") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", colour = "blue") +
  labs(
    x = "Weekly exercise dose",
    y = "Change in gait speed (m/s)",
    title = "Linear regression"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

loess_plot_vmarcha <- ggplot(
  pf_vmarcha_overall_dose,
  aes(x = weekly_dose, y = y)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "red") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", colour = "gold") +
  labs(
    x = "Weekly exercise dose",
    y = "Change in gait speed (m/s)",
    title = "LOESS"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

spline2_plot_vmarcha <- ggplot(
  pf_vmarcha_overall_dose,
  aes(x = weekly_dose, y = y)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "red") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ splines::ns(x, df = 2),
    colour = "red"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Weekly exercise dose",
    y = "Change in gait speed (m/s)",
    title = "Natural spline, 2 df"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

spline3_plot_vmarcha <- ggplot(
  pf_vmarcha_overall_dose,
  aes(x = weekly_dose, y = y)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "red") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ splines::ns(x, df = 3),
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Weekly exercise dose",
    y = "Change in gait speed (m/s)",
    title = "Natural spline, 3 df"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

gridExtra::grid.arrange(
  lin_plot_vmarcha,
  loess_plot_vmarcha,
  spline2_plot_vmarcha,
  spline3_plot_vmarcha,
  nrow = 2
)


```

## 41_statistical comprobation overall

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(splines)
library(tibble)

lm_simple_vmarcha_overall <- lm(
  y ~ weekly_dose,
  data = pf_vmarcha_overall_dose
)

lm_spline2_vmarcha_overall <- lm(
  y ~ ns(weekly_dose, df = 2),
  data = pf_vmarcha_overall_dose
)

lm_spline3_vmarcha_overall <- lm(
  y ~ ns(weekly_dose, df = 3),
  data = pf_vmarcha_overall_dose
)

anova_lin_ns2_vmarcha <- anova(
  lm_simple_vmarcha_overall,
  lm_spline2_vmarcha_overall
)

anova_lin_ns3_vmarcha <- anova(
  lm_simple_vmarcha_overall,
  lm_spline3_vmarcha_overall
)

anova_ns2_ns3_vmarcha <- anova(
  lm_spline2_vmarcha_overall,
  lm_spline3_vmarcha_overall
)

stats_overall_vmarcha <- tibble(
  outcome = "Gait speed",
  n = nrow(pf_vmarcha_overall_dose),
  n_unique_dose = n_distinct(
    pf_vmarcha_overall_dose$weekly_dose
  ),

  p_linear =
    summary(lm_simple_vmarcha_overall)$coefficients[
      "weekly_dose",
      "Pr(>|t|)"
    ],

  p_linear_vs_ns2 =
    anova_lin_ns2_vmarcha$`Pr(>F)`[2],

  p_linear_vs_ns3 =
    anova_lin_ns3_vmarcha$`Pr(>F)`[2],
```

### dose response Agent

## 45.0_dose response Agent_ESTADISTICA DE MODELOS_statistical model

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(splines)
library(purrr)

pf_vmarcha_dose_agent <- pf_vmarcha_overall %>%
  filter(
    agent != "usual care",
    !is.na(weekly_dose),
    !is.na(y)
  )

agent_split_vmarcha <- split(
  pf_vmarcha_dose_agent,
  pf_vmarcha_dose_agent$agent
)

summary_agent_vmarcha <- map_dfr(names(agent_split_vmarcha), function(agent_name){

  datos <- agent_split_vmarcha[[agent_name]]

  n_studies <- n_distinct(datos$studyID)
  n_unique_dose <- n_distinct(datos$weekly_dose)

  if(n_studies < 3 | n_unique_dose < 3){

    return(
      tibble(
        agent = agent_name,
        n_studies = n_studies,
        n_unique_dose = n_unique_dose,
        p_linear = NA,
        p_linear_vs_ns2 = NA,
        p_linear_vs_ns3 = NA,
        p_ns2_vs_ns3 = NA,
        AIC_linear = NA,
        AIC_ns2 = NA,
        AIC_ns3 = NA,
        adjR2_linear = NA,
        selected_model = "Not modelled"
      )
    )

  }

  lm_lin <- lm(
    y ~ weekly_dose,
    data = datos
  )

  lm_ns2 <- lm(
    y ~ ns(weekly_dose, df = 2),
    data = datos
  )

  lm_ns3 <- lm(
    y ~ ns(weekly_dose, df = 3),
    data = datos
  )

  tibble(

    agent = agent_name,

    n_studies = n_studies,

    n_unique_dose = n_unique_dose,

    p_linear =
      summary(lm_lin)$coefficients["weekly_dose","Pr(>|t|)"],

    p_linear_vs_ns2 =
      anova(lm_lin,lm_ns2)$`Pr(>F)`[2],

    p_linear_vs_ns3 =
      anova(lm_lin,lm_ns3)$`Pr(>F)`[2],

    p_ns2_vs_ns3 =
      anova(lm_ns2,lm_ns3)$`Pr(>F)`[2],

    AIC_linear = AIC(lm_lin),

    AIC_ns2 = AIC(lm_ns2),

    AIC_ns3 = AIC(lm_ns3),

    adjR2_linear =
      summary(lm_lin)$adj.r.squared

  )

}) %>%

  mutate(

    selected_model = case_when(

      is.na(p_linear) ~ "Not modelled",

      p_linear_vs_ns2 < 0.05 &
      (is.na(p_ns2_vs_ns3) | p_ns2_vs_ns3 >= 0.05) ~ "Spline 2",

      p_linear_vs_ns3 < 0.05 &
      p_ns2_vs_ns3 < 0.05 ~ "Spline 3",

      TRUE ~ "Linear"

    )

  )

summary_agent_vmarcha

```

### Meta-Analysis Model For Agent

## 3_Creation red_Agent

```{r}

pf_tug <- pf_tug %>%
  group_by(scale) %>%
  mutate(
    premean_c = premean - mean(premean, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()



pf_tug %>%
  group_by(scale) %>%
  summarise(
    n_arms = n(),
    n_studies = n_distinct(studyID),
    mean_premean = mean(premean, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_premean_c = mean(premean_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    missing_premean_c = sum(is.na(premean_c)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )



net_agent_tug <- set_agd_arm(
  pf_tug,
  study = studyID,
  trt = agent,
  y = y,
  se = se,
  sample_size = postn,
  trt_ref = "usual care"
)


net_agent_tug
summary(net_agent_tug)


plot(
  net_agent_tug,
  weight_edges = TRUE,
  weight_nodes = TRUE
) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

```

## 4_Model 1: Fixed-effect meta-analysis (no covariate)

```{r}
fit_FE_tug_agent <- nma(
  net_agent_tug,
  seed = 25062026,
  trt_effects = "fixed",
  prior_intercept = normal(scale = 5),
  prior_trt = normal(scale = 5)
)

fit_FE_tug_agent
```

```{r}

fit_RE_tug_agent <- nma(
  net_agent_tug,
  seed = 25062026,
  trt_effects = "random",
  prior_intercept = normal(scale = 5),
  prior_trt = normal(scale = 5),
  prior_het = half_normal(scale = 2)
)

fit_RE_tug_agent

```

## 6_Model 3:Fixed-effect meta-analysis with covariate `premean`

```{r}
fit_FE_reg_tug_agent <- nma(
  net_agent_tug,
  seed = 25062026,
  trt_effects = "fixed",
  regression = ~ .trt:premean_c,
  prior_intercept = normal(scale = 5),
  prior_trt = normal(scale = 5),
  prior_reg = normal(scale = 1),
  adapt_delta = 0.99
)

```

```{r}
)
```

```{r}
pf_tug_trt <- pf_tug %>%
  mutate(
    trt = case_when(
      trt == "Tai Chi" ~ "mind body",
      trt == "wii" ~ "exergame",
      trt == "virtual reality" ~ "exergame",
      trt == "areobic+resistance" ~ "aerobic+resistance",
      trt == "theraband" ~ "resistance training",
      trt == "aerobic+resistance+stretching" ~ "aerobic+resistance",
      trt == "resistance+balance+stretching" ~ "resistance+balance",
      TRUE ~ trt
    )
  )

  count(trt, sort = TRUE)

  group_by(trt) %>%
  summarise(
    n_arms = n(),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
```

```{r}
lm_simple_tug_overall <- lm(
  y ~ weekly_dose,
  data = pf_tug_overall_dose
)

  y ~ splines::ns(weekly_dose, df = 2),
  data = pf_tug_overall_dose
)

  y ~ splines::ns(weekly_dose, df = 3),

anova_linear_vs_spline2_tug <- anova(
  lm_simple_tug_overall,
  lm_spline2_tug_overall
)

anova_linear_vs_spline3_tug <- anova(
  lm_simple_tug_overall,
  lm_spline3_tug_overall
)

anova_spline2_vs_spline3_tug <- anova(
  lm_spline2_tug_overall,
  lm_spline3_tug_overall
)


p_linear_tug <- coef(
  summary(lm_simple_tug_overall)
)["weekly_dose", "Pr(>|t|)"]

p_linear_vs_spline2_tug <-
  anova_linear_vs_spline2_tug$`Pr(>F)`[2]

p_linear_vs_spline3_tug <-
  anova_linear_vs_spline3_tug$`Pr(>F)`[2]

p_spline2_vs_spline3_tug <-
  anova_spline2_vs_spline3_tug$`Pr(>F)`[2]


aic_tug <- AIC(
  lm_simple_tug_overall,
  lm_spline2_tug_overall,
  lm_spline3_tug_overall
)


comparison_tug_overall <- tibble(
  outcome = "Functional mobility (TUG)",
  n = nrow(pf_tug_overall_dose),
  n_studies = n_distinct(
    pf_tug_overall_dose$studyID
  ),
  n_unique_dose = n_distinct(
    pf_tug_overall_dose$weekly_dose
  ),
  p_linear = p_linear_tug,
  p_linear_vs_ns2 = p_linear_vs_spline2_tug,
  p_linear_vs_ns3 = p_linear_vs_spline3_tug,
  p_ns2_vs_ns3 = p_spline2_vs_spline3_tug,
  AIC_linear = AIC(lm_simple_tug_overall),
  AIC_ns2 = AIC(lm_spline2_tug_overall),
  AIC_ns3 = AIC(lm_spline3_tug_overall),
  adjusted_R2_linear =
    summary(lm_simple_tug_overall)$adj.r.squared,
  adjusted_R2_ns2 =
    summary(lm_spline2_tug_overall)$adj.r.squared,
  adjusted_R2_ns3 =
    summary(lm_spline3_tug_overall)$adj.r.squared
) %>%
  mutate(
    selected_model = case_when(

      p_linear_vs_ns2 < 0.05 &
        (
          is.na(p_ns2_vs_ns3) |
            p_ns2_vs_ns3 >= 0.05
        ) ~
        "Spline 2",

      p_linear_vs_ns3 < 0.05 &
        p_ns2_vs_ns3 < 0.05 ~
        "Spline 3",

      TRUE ~
        "Linear"
    )
  )
```

### strengh # Lower is better = FALSE

## 1_filter domain 

```{r} 

## 1_filter domain chair-stand 

pf_chair_stand <- data %>%
  filter(
    outcome == "physical function",
    scale %in% c(
      "30CSTS_times",
      "FTSTS"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pren = as.numeric(pren),
    premean = as.numeric(premean),
    postn = as.numeric(postn),
    postmean = as.numeric(postmean),
    y_raw = as.numeric(y),
    se_diff = as.numeric(se_diff),
    weekly_dose = as.numeric(weekly_dose),

    sd_change = se_diff * sqrt(postn),

    y_harm = case_when(
      scale == "FTSTS" ~ -y_raw,
      scale == "30CSTS_times" ~ y_raw,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    smc_unadjusted = y_harm / sd_change,

    J = 1 - 3 / (4 * postn - 9),

    smc_hedges = J * smc_unadjusted
  )

pf_chair_stand %>%
  group_by(scale) %>%
  summarise(
    n_arms = n(),
    n_studies = n_distinct(studyID),

    missing_y_raw = sum(is.na(y_raw)),
    missing_y_harm = sum(is.na(y_harm)),
    missing_se_diff = sum(is.na(se_diff)),
    missing_sd_change = sum(is.na(sd_change)),
    missing_smc = sum(is.na(smc_hedges)),

    mean_raw_change = mean(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_harmonised_change = mean(y_harm, na.rm = TRUE),

    min_harmonised_change = min(y_harm, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_harmonised_change = max(y_harm, na.rm = TRUE),

    min_sd_change = min(sd_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_sd_change = max(sd_change, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_smc = mean(smc_hedges, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_smc = min(smc_hedges, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_smc = max(smc_hedges, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

### Meta-Analysis Model For Agent

## 3_Creation red_Agent

```{r}
## 3_Creation de contrastes estandarizados y red_Agent


pf_chair_stand_std <- pf_chair_stand %>%
  group_by(studyID) %>%
  mutate(
    df_pool_change = sum(
      postn - 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    pooled_sd_change = sqrt(
      sum(
        (postn - 1) * sd_change^2,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) /
        df_pool_change
    ),

    J_study = exp(
      lgamma(df_pool_change / 2) -
        0.5 * log(df_pool_change / 2) -
        lgamma((df_pool_change - 1) / 2)
    ),

    standardised_arm_change =
      J_study * y_harm / pooled_sd_change,

    standardised_arm_se =
      J_study * se_diff / pooled_sd_change
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

pf_chair_stand_std %>%
  summarise(
    missing_pooled_sd = sum(is.na(pooled_sd_change)),
    nonpositive_pooled_sd = sum(
      pooled_sd_change <= 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    missing_standardised_change = sum(
      is.na(standardised_arm_change)
    ),
    missing_standardised_se = sum(
      is.na(standardised_arm_se)
    ),
    min_standardised_change = min(
      standardised_arm_change,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    max_standardised_change = max(
      standardised_arm_change,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

pf_chair_stand_std %>%
  select(
    studyID,
    scale,
    agent,
    trt,
    postn,
    y_harm,
    sd_change,
    pooled_sd_change,
    J_study,
    standardised_arm_change,
    standardised_arm_se
  ) %>%
  arrange(studyID, agent)

chair_stand_contrast_agent <- pf_chair_stand_std %>%
  group_by(studyID) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ {

      datos_estudio <- .x

      ref_index <- if (
        any(datos_estudio$agent == "usual care")
      ) {
        which(datos_estudio$agent == "usual care")[1]
      } else {
        1
      }

      ref_change <- datos_estudio$standardised_arm_change[
        ref_index
      ]

      ref_se <- datos_estudio$standardised_arm_se[
        ref_index
      ]

      ref_agent <- as.character(
        datos_estudio$agent[ref_index]
      )

      datos_estudio %>%
        mutate(
          reference_agent = ref_agent,

          is_reference_arm =
            row_number() == ref_index,

          y_smd = if_else(
            is_reference_arm,
            NA_real_,
            standardised_arm_change - ref_change
          ),

          se_smd = if_else(
            is_reference_arm,
            ref_se,
            sqrt(
              standardised_arm_se^2 +
                ref_se^2
            )
          )
        )
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

chair_stand_contrast_agent %>%
  select(
    studyID,
    scale,
    reference_agent,
    agent,
    is_reference_arm,
    postn,
    y_smd,
    se_smd
  ) %>%
  arrange(studyID, desc(is_reference_arm), agent)

chair_stand_contrast_agent %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_studies = n_distinct(studyID),
    n_reference_rows = sum(is_reference_arm),
    missing_y_reference = sum(
      is_reference_arm & is.na(y_smd)
    ),
    nonmissing_y_reference = sum(
      is_reference_arm & !is.na(y_smd)
    ),
    missing_y_nonreference = sum(
      !is_reference_arm & is.na(y_smd)
    ),
    missing_se = sum(is.na(se_smd)),
    min_y_smd = min(y_smd, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_y_smd = max(y_smd, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

net_agent_chair_stand <- set_agd_contrast(
  chair_stand_contrast_agent,
  study = studyID,
  trt = agent,
  y = y_smd,
  se = se_smd,
  sample_size = postn,
  trt_ref = "usual care"
)

net_agent_chair_stand
summary(net_agent_chair_stand)

plot(
  net_agent_chair_stand,
  weight_edges = TRUE,
  weight_nodes = TRUE
) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )



```

```{r}
  seed = 25062026,
  trt_effects = "fixed",
  prior_intercept = normal(scale = 1),
  prior_trt = normal(scale = 1)
)

fit_FE_chair_agent
```

```{r}
  prior_intercept = normal(scale = 1),

)
```

```{r}
## 41_statistical comprobation overall

if (nrow(pf_chair_overall_dose) < 5) {
  stop("No hay suficientes observaciones.")
}


lm_simple_chair <- lm(
  y ~ weekly_dose,
  data = pf_chair_overall_dose
)

lm_spline2_chair <- lm(
  y ~ splines::ns(
    weekly_dose,
    df = 2
  ),
  data = pf_chair_overall_dose
)

lm_spline3_chair <- lm(
  y ~ splines::ns(
    weekly_dose,
    df = 3
  ),
  data = pf_chair_overall_dose
)


anova_linear_vs_spline2_chair <-
  anova(
    lm_simple_chair,
    lm_spline2_chair
  )

anova_linear_vs_spline3_chair <-
  anova(
    lm_simple_chair,
    lm_spline3_chair
  )

anova_spline2_vs_spline3_chair <-
  anova(
    lm_spline2_chair,
    lm_spline3_chair
  )


p_linear_chair <-
  coef(
    summary(
      lm_simple_chair
    )
  )[
    "weekly_dose",
    "Pr(>|t|)"
  ]

p_linear_vs_ns2_chair <-
  anova_linear_vs_spline2_chair$`Pr(>F)`[2]

p_linear_vs_ns3_chair <-
  anova_linear_vs_spline3_chair$`Pr(>F)`[2]

p_ns2_vs_ns3_chair <-
  anova_spline2_vs_spline3_chair$`Pr(>F)`[2]


comparison_chair_overall <-
  tibble(

    outcome =
      "Lower-limb strength",

    n =
      nrow(
        pf_chair_overall_dose
      ),

    n_studies =
      n_distinct(
        pf_chair_overall_dose$studyID
      ),

    n_unique_dose =
      n_distinct(
        pf_chair_overall_dose$weekly_dose
      ),

    p_linear =
      p_linear_chair,

    p_linear_vs_ns2 =
      p_linear_vs_ns2_chair,

    p_linear_vs_ns3 =
      p_linear_vs_ns3_chair,

    p_ns2_vs_ns3 =
      p_ns2_vs_ns3_chair,

    AIC_linear =
      AIC(
        lm_simple_chair
      ),

    AIC_ns2 =
      AIC(
        lm_spline2_chair
      ),

    AIC_ns3 =
      AIC(
        lm_spline3_chair
      ),

    adjusted_R2_linear =
      summary(
        lm_simple_chair
      )$adj.r.squared,

    adjusted_R2_ns2 =
      summary(
        lm_spline2_chair
      )$adj.r.squared,

    adjusted_R2_ns3 =
      summary(
        lm_spline3_chair
      )$adj.r.squared

  ) %>%
  mutate(

    selected_model =
      case_when(

        p_linear_vs_ns2 < 0.05 &
          (
            is.na(
              p_ns2_vs_ns3
            ) |
              p_ns2_vs_ns3 >= 0.05
          ) ~
          "Spline 2",

        p_linear_vs_ns3 < 0.05 &
          p_ns2_vs_ns3 < 0.05 ~
          "Spline 3",

        TRUE ~
          "Linear"

      )

  )

comparison_chair_overall
```

```{r}


dose_range_chair <- range(

  weekly_dose = seq(
    from = dose_range_chair[1],
    to = dose_range_chair[2],
    length.out = 5000
  )

  lm_spline2_chair,
  newdata = dose_grid_chair_spline,
  interval = "confidence",
  level = 0.95
)

pred_df_chair_spline <- bind_cols(
  dose_grid_chair_spline,
  as.data.frame(pred_chair_spline)
)


optimal_row_chair_spline <- pred_df_chair_spline %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = fit,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  )

optimal_dose_chair_spline <-
  optimal_row_chair_spline$weekly_dose

optimal_effect_chair_spline <-
  optimal_row_chair_spline$fit

optimal_effect_lwr_chair_spline <-
  optimal_row_chair_spline$lwr

optimal_effect_upr_chair_spline <-
  optimal_row_chair_spline$upr


grid_step_chair <-
  dose_grid_chair_spline$weekly_dose[2] -
  dose_grid_chair_spline$weekly_dose[1]

internal_optimum_chair_spline <-
  optimal_dose_chair_spline >
    dose_range_chair[1] + grid_step_chair &
  optimal_dose_chair_spline <
    dose_range_chair[2] - grid_step_chair

optimum_location_chair_spline <- case_when(
  internal_optimum_chair_spline ~
    "Internal maximum",

  abs(
    optimal_dose_chair_spline -
      dose_range_chair[1]
  ) <= grid_step_chair ~
    "Lower boundary",

  abs(
    optimal_dose_chair_spline -
      dose_range_chair[2]
  ) <= grid_step_chair ~
    "Upper boundary",

  TRUE ~
    "Undetermined"
)

    optimal_effect_chair_spline,
  predicted_effect_CI_low =
    optimal_effect_lwr_chair_spline,
  predicted_effect_CI_high =
    optimal_effect_upr_chair_spline,
  optimum_location =
    optimum_location_chair_spline,
  internal_optimum =
    internal_optimum_chair_spline
)

optimal_dose_result_chair_spline
```

## 46_dose optimal exploracion inicial

```{r}


pf_chair_dose_agent <- pf_chair_dose %>%
  filter(
    agent %in% c(
      "multicomponent",
      "resistance",
      "aerobic"
    ),
    !is.na(weekly_dose),
    !is.na(y)
  )

agent_split_chair <- split(
  pf_chair_dose_agent,
  pf_chair_dose_agent$agent
)

comparison_agent_chair <- purrr::map_dfr(
  names(agent_split_chair),
  function(nombre_agent){

    datos <- agent_split_chair[[nombre_agent]]

    modelo_lin <- lm(
      y ~ weekly_dose,
      data = datos
    )

    modelo_ns2 <- lm(
      y ~ splines::ns(
        weekly_dose,
        df = 2
      ),
      data = datos
    )

    modelo_ns3 <- lm(
      y ~ splines::ns(
        weekly_dose,
        df = 3
      ),
      data = datos
    )

    anova_lin_ns2 <- anova(
      modelo_lin,
      modelo_ns2
    )

    anova_lin_ns3 <- anova(
      modelo_lin,
      modelo_ns3
    )

    anova_ns2_ns3 <- anova(
      modelo_ns2,
      modelo_ns3
    )

    tibble(

      agent = nombre_agent,

      n_arms = nrow(datos),

      n_studies =
        n_distinct(datos$studyID),

      n_unique_doses =
        n_distinct(datos$weekly_dose),

      p_linear =
        coef(summary(modelo_lin))[
          "weekly_dose",
          "Pr(>|t|)"
        ],

      p_linear_vs_ns2 =
        anova_lin_ns2$`Pr(>F)`[2],

      p_linear_vs_ns3 =
        anova_lin_ns3$`Pr(>F)`[2],

      p_ns2_vs_ns3 =
        anova_ns2_ns3$`Pr(>F)`[2],

      AIC_linear =
        AIC(modelo_lin),

      AIC_ns2 =
        AIC(modelo_ns2),

      AIC_ns3 =
        AIC(modelo_ns3),

      adjR2_linear =
        summary(modelo_lin)$adj.r.squared,

      adjR2_ns2 =
        summary(modelo_ns2)$adj.r.squared,

      adjR2_ns3 =
        summary(modelo_ns3)$adj.r.squared,

      selected_model =
        case_when(

          anova_lin_ns2$`Pr(>F)`[2] < 0.05 &
          anova_ns2_ns3$`Pr(>F)`[2] >= 0.05
          ~ "Spline 2 df",

          anova_lin_ns3$`Pr(>F)`[2] < 0.05 &
          anova_ns2_ns3$`Pr(>F)`[2] < 0.05
          ~ "Spline 3 df",

          TRUE
          ~ "Linear"

        )

    )

  }

)

comparison_agent_chair
```

### Meta-Analysis Model For Agent

## 3_Creation red_Agent

```{r}


pf_balance <- pf_balance %>%
  filter(
    !agent %in% c(
      "aerobic",
      "stretching"
    )
  )

mean_premean_balance <- mean(
  pf_balance$premean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

pf_balance <- pf_balance %>%
  mutate(
    premean_c = premean - mean_premean_balance
  )

pf_balance %>%
  summarise(
    mean_premean = mean(
      premean,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mean_premean_c = mean(
      premean_c,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    min_premean_c = min(
      premean_c,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    max_premean_c = max(
      premean_c,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

pf_balance %>%
  count(
    agent,
    sort = TRUE
  )

pf_balance %>%
  count(
    studyID,
    name = "n_arms"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    n_arms,
    studyID
  )

pf_balance %>%
  count(
    studyID,
    name = "n_arms"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n_arms < 2
  )

net_balance_agent <- set_agd_arm(
  pf_balance,
  study = studyID,
  trt = agent,
  y = y,
  se = se,
  sample_size = postn,
  trt_ref = "usual care"
)

net_balance_agent

plot(
  net_balance_agent,
  weight_edges = TRUE,
  weight_nodes = TRUE
)

```

```{r}
fit_FE_balance
```

```{r}
    )
```

## 41_statistical comprobation overall

```{r}
## 41_statistical comprobation overall



lm_simple_balance <- lm(
  y ~ weekly_dose,
  data = pf_balance_overall_dose
)



lm_spline2_balance <- lm(
  y ~ splines::ns(
    weekly_dose,
    df = 2
  ),
  data = pf_balance_overall_dose
)



lm_spline3_balance <- lm(
  y ~ splines::ns(
    weekly_dose,
    df = 3
  ),
  data = pf_balance_overall_dose
)



anova_linear_vs_spline2_balance <-
  anova(
    lm_simple_balance,
    lm_spline2_balance
  )

anova_linear_vs_spline3_balance <-
  anova(
    lm_simple_balance,
    lm_spline3_balance
  )

anova_spline2_vs_spline3_balance <-
  anova(
    lm_spline2_balance,
    lm_spline3_balance
  )



comparison_balance_overall <-
  tibble(

    outcome = "Balance",

    n =
      nrow(
        pf_balance_overall_dose
      ),

    n_studies =
      n_distinct(
        pf_balance_overall_dose$studyID
      ),

    n_unique_doses =
      n_distinct(
        pf_balance_overall_dose$weekly_dose
      ),

    p_linear =
      coef(
        summary(
          lm_simple_balance
        )
      )[
        "weekly_dose",
        "Pr(>|t|)"
      ],

    p_linear_vs_spline2 =
      anova_linear_vs_spline2_balance$`Pr(>F)`[2],

    p_linear_vs_spline3 =
      anova_linear_vs_spline3_balance$`Pr(>F)`[2],

    p_spline2_vs_spline3 =
      anova_spline2_vs_spline3_balance$`Pr(>F)`[2],

    AIC_linear =
      AIC(
        lm_simple_balance
      ),

    AIC_spline2 =
      AIC(
        lm_spline2_balance
      ),

    AIC_spline3 =
      AIC(
        lm_spline3_balance
      ),

    adjR2_linear =
      summary(
        lm_simple_balance
      )$adj.r.squared,

    adjR2_spline2 =
      summary(
        lm_spline2_balance
      )$adj.r.squared,

    adjR2_spline3 =
      summary(
        lm_spline3_balance
      )$adj.r.squared,

    selected_model =
      case_when(

        p_linear_vs_spline2 < 0.05 &
          p_spline2_vs_spline3 >= 0.05 ~
          "Spline 2 df",

        p_linear_vs_spline3 < 0.05 &
          p_spline2_vs_spline3 < 0.05 ~
          "Spline 3 df",

        TRUE ~
          "Linear"

      )

  )

comparison_balance_overall

```


## 43_dose optimal overall para balance

```{r}


doses_balance <- seq(
  from = min(
    pf_balance_dose$weekly_dose,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  to = max(
    pf_balance_dose$weekly_dose,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  length.out = 1000
)

pred_df_balance <- data.frame(
  weekly_dose = doses_balance
)

pred_balance <- predict(
  lm_simple_balance,
  newdata = pred_df_balance,
  interval = "confidence",
  level = 0.95
)

pred_df_balance <- pred_df_balance %>%
  mutate(
    predicted = pred_balance[, "fit"],
    lower = pred_balance[, "lwr"],
    upper = pred_balance[, "upr"]
  )

optimal_index_balance <- which.max(
  pred_df_balance$predicted
)

optimal_dose_balance <-
  pred_df_balance$weekly_dose[optimal_index_balance]

optimal_response_balance <-
  pred_df_balance$predicted[optimal_index_balance]

cat(
  "dose con mayor respuesta predicha dentro del rango observado:",
  round(optimal_dose_balance, 1),
  "MET-min/week\n"
)

cat(
  "Cambio estimado en balance:",
  round(optimal_response_balance, 3),
  "\n"
)
```

### Meta-Analysis Model For Agent

## 3_Creation red_Agent

```{r}


co_coglobal_net <- co_coglobal %>%
  filter(
    !studyID %in% c(
      "Yokoi, 2015b",
      "Liu, 2025"
    )
  )


mean_premean_coglobal <- mean(
  co_coglobal_net$premean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

co_coglobal_net <- co_coglobal_net %>%
  mutate(
    premean_c = premean - mean_premean_coglobal
  )


co_coglobal_net %>%
  summarise(
    n_studies = n_distinct(studyID),
    n_arms = n(),
    n_agents = n_distinct(agent)
  )

co_coglobal_net %>%
  group_by(agent) %>%
  summarise(
    n_arms = n(),
    n_studies = n_distinct(studyID),
    n_participants = sum(postn, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


net_agent_coglobal <- set_agd_arm(
  co_coglobal_net,
  study = studyID,
  trt = agent,
  y = y,
  se = se,
  sample_size = postn,
  trt_ref = "usual care"
)


net_agent_coglobal


plot(
  net_agent_coglobal,
  weight_edges = TRUE,
  weight_nodes = TRUE
)



```

## 4_Model 1: Fixed-effect meta-analysis (no covariate)

```{r}
fit_FE_coglobal <- nma(
  net_agent_coglobal,
  seed = 25062026,
  trt_effects = "fixed",
  prior_intercept = normal(scale = 1),
  prior_trt = normal(scale = 1)
)

fit_FE_coglobal

```

## 5_Model 2: Random-effects model (no covariate)

```{r}

fit_RE_coglobal <- nma(
  net_agent_coglobal,
  seed = 25062026,
  trt_effects = "random",
  prior_intercept = normal(scale = 1),
  prior_trt = normal(scale = 1),
  prior_het = half_normal(scale = 0.5),
  adapt_delta = 0.99
)

fit_RE_coglobal

```

## 6_Model 3:Fixed-effect meta-analysis with covariate `premean`

```{r}
fit_FE_reg_coglobal <- nma(
  net_agent_coglobal,
  seed = 25062026,
  trt_effects = "fixed",
  regression = ~ .trt:premean_c,
  prior_intercept = normal(scale = 1),
  prior_trt = normal(scale = 1),
  prior_reg = normal(scale = 1),
  adapt_delta = 0.99
)

fit_FE_reg_coglobal

```

## 7_Model 4:Random-effects meta-analysis with covariate `premean`

```{r}
fit_RE_reg_coglobal <- nma(
  net_agent_coglobal,
  seed = 25062026,
  trt_effects = "random",
  regression = ~ .trt:premean_c,
  prior_intercept = normal(scale = 1),
  prior_trt = normal(scale = 1),
  prior_reg = normal(scale = 1),

)

fit_RE_reg_coglobal

```

## 43_dose optimal overall para cognition

```{r}



co_coglobal_dose_linear <- co_coglobal_dose_complete %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(weekly_dose),
    !is.na(y)
  )



lm_linear_coglobal <- lm(
  y ~ weekly_dose,
  data = co_coglobal_dose_linear
)

summary(lm_linear_coglobal)



doses_coglobal <- seq(
  from = min(
    co_coglobal_dose_linear$weekly_dose,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  to = max(
    co_coglobal_dose_linear$weekly_dose,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  length.out = 1000
)



pred_matrix_coglobal <- predict(
  lm_linear_coglobal,
  newdata = data.frame(
    weekly_dose = doses_coglobal
  ),
  interval = "confidence",
  level = 0.95
)


pred_df_coglobal <- data.frame(
  weekly_dose = doses_coglobal,
  predicted = pred_matrix_coglobal[, "fit"],
  lower = pred_matrix_coglobal[, "lwr"],
  upper = pred_matrix_coglobal[, "upr"]
)


optimal_index_coglobal <- which.max(
  pred_df_coglobal$predicted
)

highest_dose_coglobal <-
  pred_df_coglobal$weekly_dose[
    optimal_index_coglobal
  ]

highest_response_coglobal <-
  pred_df_coglobal$predicted[
    optimal_index_coglobal
  ]

highest_response_lower_coglobal <-
  pred_df_coglobal$lower[
    optimal_index_coglobal
  ]

highest_response_upper_coglobal <-
  pred_df_coglobal$upper[
    optimal_index_coglobal
  ]


cat(
  "Highest evaluated dose:",
  round(highest_dose_coglobal, 1),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Predicted global cognition effect:",
  round(highest_response_coglobal, 3),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "95% confidence interval:",
  round(highest_response_lower_coglobal, 3),
  "to",
  round(highest_response_upper_coglobal, 3),
  "\n"
)

```

```{r}
      x = weekly_dose,
      y = predicted
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "red",
    size = 3
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = optimal_dose_spline_coglobal,
    y = optimal_response_spline_coglobal,
    label = paste0(
      "Highest predicted response\n",
      round(optimal_dose_spline_coglobal, 0),
      " dose units/week"
    ),
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = -0.8,
    colour = "red"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Weekly physical activity dose",
    y = "Global cognition effect",
    title = "Exploratory nonlinear dose–response relationship",
    subtitle = "Natural spline with 2 degrees of freedom"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

spline_optimal_plot_coglobal

pred_linear_comparison_coglobal <- pred_df_coglobal %>%
  transmute(
    weekly_dose,
    predicted,
    model = "Linear model"
  )

pred_spline_comparison_coglobal <- pred_spline_df_coglobal %>%
  transmute(
    weekly_dose,
    predicted,
    model = "Natural spline (2 df)"
  )

pred_models_coglobal <- bind_rows(
  pred_linear_comparison_coglobal,
  pred_spline_comparison_coglobal
)


ggplot(
  co_coglobal_dose_spline,
  aes(
    x = weekly_dose,
    y = y
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    colour = "red",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.55
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = pred_models_coglobal,
    aes(
      x = weekly_dose,
      y = predicted,
      linetype = model
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Weekly physical activity dose",
    y = "Global cognition effect",
```

## 40_exploratory graph overall

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(splines)
library(gridExtra)

if (!all(c("weekly_dose", "y") %in% names(caida))) {
  stop(
    "La tabla `caida` no tiene las columnas necesarias: ",
    "'weekly_dose' y 'y'"
  )
}

caida_dose <- caida %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(weekly_dose),
    !is.na(y)
  )

dose_limits_caida <- quantile(
  caida_dose$weekly_dose,
  probs = c(0.05, 0.95),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

base_plot_caida <- ggplot(
  caida_dose,
  aes(x = weekly_dose, y = y)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    colour = "red",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = dose_limits_caida,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_rug(
    sides = "b",
    alpha = 0.35
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Weekly physical activity dose (min/week)",
    y = "Change in balance performance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

lin_plot_caida <- base_plot_caida +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE
  ) +
  labs(title = "Linear regression")

loess_plot_caida <- base_plot_caida +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    span = 0.75
  ) +
  labs(title = "LOESS")

spline2_plot_caida <- base_plot_caida +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ ns(x, df = 2),
    se = TRUE
  ) +
  labs(title = "Natural spline (2 df)")

spline3_plot_caida <- base_plot_caida +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ ns(x, df = 3),
    se = TRUE
  ) +
  labs(title = "Natural spline (3 df)")

grid.arrange(
  lin_plot_caida,
  loess_plot_caida,
  spline2_plot_caida,
  spline3_plot_caida,
  nrow = 2
)
```

## 41_statistical comprobation overall

```{r}
lm_simple_caida <- lm(
  y ~ weekly_dose,
  data = caida_dose
)

lm_spline2_caida <- lm(
  y ~ ns(weekly_dose, df = 2),
  data = caida_dose
)

lm_spline3_caida <- lm(
  y ~ ns(weekly_dose, df = 3),
  data = caida_dose
)

summary(lm_simple_caida)
summary(lm_spline2_caida)
summary(lm_spline3_caida)

anova(lm_simple_caida, lm_spline2_caida)
anova(lm_simple_caida, lm_spline3_caida)

anova(lm_spline2_caida, lm_spline3_caida)

model_fit_caida <- tibble(
  model = c(
    "Linear",
    "Natural spline, 2 df",
    "Natural spline, 3 df"
  ),
  parameters = c(
    length(coef(lm_simple_caida)),
    length(coef(lm_spline2_caida)),
    length(coef(lm_spline3_caida))
  ),
  RSS = c(
    deviance(lm_simple_caida),
    deviance(lm_spline2_caida),
    deviance(lm_spline3_caida)
  ),
  R2 = c(
    summary(lm_simple_caida)$r.squared,
    summary(lm_spline2_caida)$r.squared,
    summary(lm_spline3_caida)$r.squared
  ),
  adjusted_R2 = c(
    summary(lm_simple_caida)$adj.r.squared,
    summary(lm_spline2_caida)$adj.r.squared,
    summary(lm_spline3_caida)$adj.r.squared
  ),
  AIC = c(
    AIC(lm_simple_caida),
    AIC(lm_spline2_caida),
    AIC(lm_spline3_caida)
  ),
  BIC = c(
    BIC(lm_simple_caida),
    BIC(lm_spline2_caida),
    BIC(lm_spline3_caida)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_AIC = AIC - min(AIC),
    delta_BIC = BIC - min(BIC)
  ) %>%
  arrange(AIC)

model_fit_caida

```


## 43_dose optimal overall para caida

```{r}

## 43_Estimated peak dose (exploratory)

lm_spline2_caida <- lm(
  y ~ ns(weekly_dose, df = 2),
  data = caida_dose
)

dose_grid_caida <- tibble(
  weekly_dose = seq(
    min(caida_dose$weekly_dose),
    max(caida_dose$weekly_dose),
    length.out = 1000
  )
)

dose_grid_caida$predicted <- predict(
  lm_spline2_caida,
  newdata = dose_grid_caida
)

peak_index_caida <- which.max(dose_grid_caida$predicted)

peak_dose_caida <- dose_grid_caida$weekly_dose[peak_index_caida]
peak_response_caida <- dose_grid_caida$predicted[peak_index_caida]

cat(
  "Estimated peak dose:",
  round(peak_dose_caida, 1),
  "METs/week\n"
)

cat(
  "Maximum predicted response:",
  round(peak_response_caida, 3),
  "\n"
```

### dose response Agent

## 45_dose response por agent

```{r}
library(splines)
library(dplyr)
library(broom)

caida_dose_agent <- caida_dose %>%
  filter(agent != "usual care")

agent_split_caida <- split(
  caida_dose_agent,
  caida_dose_agent$agent
)

results_agent_caida <- list()

for (nombre_agent in names(agent_split_caida)) {

  datos <- agent_split_caida[[nombre_agent]]

  if (nrow(datos) < 5 || length(unique(datos$weekly_dose)) < 4) {
    next
  }

  modelo_lin <- lm(y ~ weekly_dose, data = datos)
  modelo_ns2 <- lm(y ~ ns(weekly_dose, df = 2), data = datos)
  modelo_ns3 <- lm(y ~ ns(weekly_dose, df = 3), data = datos)

  comp12 <- anova(modelo_lin, modelo_ns2)
  comp13 <- anova(modelo_lin, modelo_ns3)
  comp23 <- anova(modelo_ns2, modelo_ns3)

  results_agent_caida[[nombre_agent]] <-
    tibble(
      agent = nombre_agent,
      n = nrow(datos),

      p_linear = summary(modelo_lin)$coefficients[2,4],

      p_linear_vs_ns2 = comp12$`Pr(>F)`[2],
      p_linear_vs_ns3 = comp13$`Pr(>F)`[2],
      p_ns2_vs_ns3    = comp23$`Pr(>F)`[2],

      AIC_linear = AIC(modelo_lin),
      AIC_ns2    = AIC(modelo_ns2),
      AIC_ns3    = AIC(modelo_ns3),

      adjR2_linear = summary(modelo_lin)$adj.r.squared,
      adjR2_ns2    = summary(modelo_ns2)$adj.r.squared,
      adjR2_ns3    = summary(modelo_ns3)$adj.r.squared
    )
}

results_agent_caida <-
  bind_rows(results_agent_caida) %>%
  arrange(p_linear_vs_ns2)

results_agent_caida
```

## 46_optimal dose agent

```{r}
optima_agent_caida <- map(agent_split_caida, function(datos) {
  
  if (nrow(datos) < 5 || length(unique(datos$weekly_dose)) < 4) return(NULL)
  
  modelo <- lm(y ~ ns(weekly_dose, 2), data = datos)
  
  dose_seq <- seq(
    min(datos$weekly_dose, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(datos$weekly_dose, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 1000
  )
  
  predicciones <- predict(
    modelo,
    newdata = data.frame(weekly_dose = dose_seq)
  )
  
  opt_index <- which.max(predicciones)
  opt_dose <- dose_seq[opt_index]
  opt_resp <- predicciones[opt_index]
  
  tibble(
    agent = unique(datos$agent),
    n = nrow(datos),
    n_unique_dose = n_distinct(datos$weekly_dose),
    optimal_dose = round(opt_dose, 1),
    predicted_change = round(opt_resp, 3)
  )
})

optima_agent_caida_tbl <- bind_rows(optima_agent_caida)

optima_agent_caida_tbl

```

### dose response Agent Multicomponent y Resistance

```{r}
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(splines)

optima_agent_caida <- map(agent_split_caida, function(datos){

  if (nrow(datos) < 5 || n_distinct(datos$weekly_dose) < 4)
    return(NULL)

  agent_name <- unique(datos$agent)

  if(agent_name == "multicomponent"){
    modelo <- lm(y ~ ns(weekly_dose, df = 3), data = datos)
    spline_df <- 3
  } else if(agent_name == "resistance"){
    modelo <- lm(y ~ ns(weekly_dose, df = 2), data = datos)
    spline_df <- 2
  } else{
    return(NULL)
  }

  dose_seq <- seq(
    min(datos$weekly_dose),
    max(datos$weekly_dose),
    length.out = 1000
  )

  pred_df <- tibble(
    weekly_dose = dose_seq,
    predicted = predict(
      modelo,
      newdata = tibble(weekly_dose = dose_seq)
    )
  )

  peak_index <- which.max(pred_df$predicted)

  tibble(
    agent = agent_name,
    spline = spline_df,
    n = nrow(datos),
    n_unique_dose = n_distinct(datos$weekly_dose),
    peak_dose = round(pred_df$weekly_dose[peak_index],1),
    predicted_change = round(pred_df$predicted[peak_index],3)
  )

})

optima_agent_caida_tbl <-
  bind_rows(optima_agent_caida)

optima_agent_caida_tbl


```

### RELATIVE EFFECTS LEVEL 1

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(multinma)





overall_outcomes <- list(

  "Gait speed" =
    pf_vmarcha,

  "Lower-limb strength" =
    pf_chair,

  "Balance" =
    pf_balance

)



prepare_overall_data <- function(
  data,
  outcome_name
) {

  

  required_variables <- c(
    "studyID",
    "agent",
    "y",
    "se"
  )

  missing_variables <- setdiff(
    required_variables,
    names(data)
  )

  if (length(missing_variables) > 0) {

    stop(
      "En el outcome '",
      outcome_name,
      "' faltan las variables: ",
      paste(
        missing_variables,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }


 

  data_overall <- data %>%
    mutate(

      studyID =
        as.character(studyID),

      agent =
        str_to_lower(
          str_trim(
            as.character(agent)
          )
        ),

      overall =
        case_when(

          agent %in% c(
            "usual care",
            "usual-care",
            "usual_care",
            "control",
            "standard care"
          ) ~
            "usual care",

          TRUE ~
            "exercise"
        )

    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(studyID),
      !is.na(overall),
      !is.na(y),
      !is.na(se),
      is.finite(y),
      is.finite(se),
      se > 0
    )


  


  data_overall_combined <- data_overall %>%
    mutate(
      precision_weight =
        1 / se^2
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      studyID,
      overall
    ) %>%
    summarise(

      y =
        sum(
          y * precision_weight
        ) /
        sum(
          precision_weight
        ),

      se =
        sqrt(
          1 /
            sum(
              precision_weight
            )
        ),

      n_original_arms =
        n(),

      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      outcome =
        outcome_name
    )


  

  eligible_studies <- data_overall_combined %>%
    group_by(studyID) %>%
    summarise(

      has_usual_care =
        any(
          overall == "usual care"
        ),

      has_exercise =
        any(
          overall == "exercise"
        ),

      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      has_usual_care,
      has_exercise
    ) %>%
    pull(studyID)


  data_overall_combined <- data_overall_combined %>%
    filter(
      studyID %in% eligible_studies
    ) %>%
    mutate(

      overall =
        factor(
          overall,
          levels = c(
            "usual care",
            "exercise"
          )
        )
    )


 

  if (n_distinct(
    data_overall_combined$studyID
  ) == 0) {

    stop(
      "No existen estudios con comparación directa ",
      "exercise vs usual care para el outcome '",
      outcome_name,
      "'."
    )
  }


  return(
    data_overall_combined
  )
}




overall_data <- imap(
  overall_outcomes,
  ~ prepare_overall_data(
    data = .x,
    outcome_name = .y
  )
)



overall_data_check <- imap_dfr(
  overall_data,
  function(
    data,
    outcome_name
  ) {

    data %>%
      summarise(

        outcome =
          outcome_name,

        n_studies =
          n_distinct(studyID),

        n_rows_combined =
          n(),

        n_usual_care_arms =
          sum(
            overall == "usual care"
          ),

        n_exercise_arms =
          sum(
            overall == "exercise"
          ),

        original_usual_care_arms =
          sum(
            n_original_arms[
              overall == "usual care"
            ]
          ),

        original_exercise_arms =
          sum(
            n_original_arms[
              overall == "exercise"
            ]
          )
      )
  }
)

overall_data_check %>%
  print(
    n = Inf,
    width = Inf
  )



fit_overall_model <- function(
  data,
  outcome_name,
  trt_effects = "random"
) {

  ## Crear red de dos tratamientos

  network <- set_agd_arm(

    data = data,

    study = studyID,

    trt = overall,

    y = y,

    se = se,

    trt_ref = "usual care"
  )


  ## Ajustar modelo NMA

  model <- nma(

    network,

    trt_effects =
      trt_effects,

    consistency =
      "consistency"
  )


  relative_effect <- relative_effects(

    model,

    trt_ref =
      "usual care",

    probs = c(
      0.025,
      0.5,
      0.975
    ),

    summary = TRUE
  )


  return(
    list(

      outcome =
        outcome_name,

      data =
        data,

      network =
        network,

      model =
        model,

      relative_effect =
        relative_effect
    )
  )
}




overall_models <- imap(
  overall_data,
  ~ fit_overall_model(
    data = .x,
    outcome_name = .y,
    trt_effects = "random"
  )
)



overall_models[
  ["Gait speed"]
]$relative_effect


overall_models[
  ["Lower-limb strength"]
]$relative_effect


overall_models[
  ["Balance"]
]$relative_effect




extract_overall_effect <- function(
  model_object
) {

  outcome_name <-
    model_object$outcome




  relative_table <- as.data.frame(
    model_object$relative_effect
  ) %>%
    rownames_to_column(
      var = "parameter"
    )


 

  exercise_row <- relative_table %>%
    filter(
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(parameter),
        "exercise"
      )
    )


  if (nrow(exercise_row) != 1) {

    stop(
      "No se ha podido identificar de forma única ",
      "el efecto de exercise en el outcome '",
      outcome_name,
      "'. Parámetros encontrados: ",
      paste(
        relative_table$parameter,
        collapse = "; "
      )
    )
  }




  exercise_result <- exercise_row %>%
    transmute(

      outcome =
        outcome_name,

      treatment =
        "exercise",

      reference =
        "usual care",

      relative_effect =
        mean,

      posterior_median =
        `50%`,

      CrI_low =
        `2.5%`,

      CrI_high =
        `97.5%`,

      posterior_sd =
        sd,

      Rhat =
        Rhat,

      Bulk_ESS =
        Bulk_ESS,

      Tail_ESS =
        Tail_ESS
    )




  usual_care_result <- tibble(

    outcome =
      outcome_name,

    treatment =
      "usual care",

    reference =
      "usual care",

    relative_effect =
      0,

    posterior_median =
      0,

    CrI_low =
      0,

    CrI_high =
      0,

    posterior_sd =
      NA_real_,

    Rhat =
      NA_real_,

    Bulk_ESS =
      NA_real_,

    Tail_ESS =
      NA_real_
  )


  bind_rows(
    usual_care_result,
    exercise_result
  )
}



overall_relative_effects <- map_dfr(
  overall_models,
  extract_overall_effect
)


overall_relative_effects %>%
  print(
    n = Inf,
    width = Inf
  )



overall_relative_effects <- overall_relative_effects %>%
  mutate(

    statistically_significant =
      case_when(

        treatment == "usual care" ~
          NA_character_,

        CrI_low > 0 ~
          "Favours exercise",

        CrI_high < 0 ~
          "Favours usual care",

        TRUE ~
          "No statistically significant difference"
      )
  )


overall_relative_effects %>%
  print(
    n = Inf,
    width = Inf
  )



overall_relative_effects_formatted <-
  overall_relative_effects %>%
  mutate(

    treatment =
      recode(
        treatment,
        "usual care" = "Usual care",
        "exercise" = "Exercise"
      ),

    relative_effect_CrI =
      case_when(

        treatment == "Usual care" ~
          "Reference",

        TRUE ~
          sprintf(
            "%.2f (95%% CrI %.2f to %.2f)",
            relative_effect,
            CrI_low,
            CrI_high
          )
      )
  ) %>%
  select(

    Outcome =
      outcome,

    Treatment =
      treatment,

    `Relative effect (95% CrI)` =
      relative_effect_CrI,

    Interpretation =
      statistically_significant
  )


overall_relative_effects_formatted %>%
  print(
    n = Inf,
    width = Inf
  )





overall_exercise_vs_usual_care <-
  overall_relative_effects %>%

  ) %>%

        relative_effect,

      )
  ) %>%
  select(

    Outcome =

      CrI_high,

    `Relative effect (95% CrI)` =
      relative_effect_CrI,

    Interpretation =

  )
```

### 2. standarized vs usual care
```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)


make_standardised_contrasts <- function(dat, direction = 1) {

  dat_std <- dat %>%
    mutate(
      y_analysis = direction * as.numeric(y),
      se_analysis = as.numeric(se),
      n_analysis = as.numeric(postn),

      sd_change = se_analysis * sqrt(n_analysis)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(y_analysis),
      !is.na(se_analysis),
      !is.na(n_analysis),
      n_analysis > 1,
      !is.na(sd_change),
      sd_change > 0
    ) %>%

    group_by(studyID) %>%

    mutate(
      df_pool = sum(n_analysis - 1),

      pooled_sd = sqrt(
        sum(
          (n_analysis - 1) * sd_change^2
        ) /
        df_pool
      ),

      J = exp(
        lgamma(df_pool / 2) -
          0.5 * log(df_pool / 2) -
          lgamma((df_pool - 1) / 2)
      ),

      std_arm_change =
        J * y_analysis / pooled_sd,

      std_arm_se =
        J * se_analysis / pooled_sd
    ) %>%
    ungroup()


  dat_with_uc <- dat_std %>%
    group_by(studyID) %>%
    filter(any(agent == "usual care")) %>%
    ungroup()

  uc <- dat_with_uc %>%
    filter(agent == "usual care") %>%
    select(
      studyID,
      uc_change = std_arm_change,
      uc_se = std_arm_se
    )

  active <- dat_with_uc %>%
    filter(agent != "usual care") %>%
    select(
      studyID,
      agent,
      std_arm_change,
      std_arm_se
    )

  contrasts <- active %>%
    inner_join(
      uc,
      by = "studyID",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      effect = std_arm_change - uc_change,

      se_effect = sqrt(
        std_arm_se^2 +
          uc_se^2
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      studyID,
      agent,
      effect,
      se_effect
    )

  contrasts
}


```

### 7. number studies analysis

```{r}

install.packages("officer")
install.packages("flextable")
library(dplyr)
library(officer)
library(flextable)



summarise_agent_support <- function(dat, outcome_name) {

  dat %>%
    group_by(agent) %>%
    summarise(
      outcome = outcome_name,
      n_studies = n_distinct(studyID),
      n_arms = n(),
      n_participants = sum(postn, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(n_studies),
      desc(n_arms)
    )
}


summarise_trt_support <- function(dat, outcome_name) {

  dat %>%
    group_by(trt) %>%
    summarise(
      outcome = outcome_name,
      n_studies = n_distinct(studyID),
      n_arms = n(),
      n_participants = sum(postn, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(n_studies),
      desc(n_arms)
    )
}



support_agent_tug <- summarise_agent_support(
  pf_tug,
  "Functional mobility (TUG)"
)

support_agent_chair <- summarise_agent_support(
  pf_chair_stand,
  "Lower-limb functional strength"
)

support_agent_gait <- summarise_agent_support(
  pf_vmarcha,
  "Gait speed"
)

support_agent_balance <- summarise_agent_support(
  pf_balance,
  "Balance"
)



support_agent_all <- bind_rows(
  support_agent_tug,
  support_agent_chair,
  support_agent_gait,
  support_agent_balance
) %>%
  select(
    outcome,
    agent,
    n_studies,
    n_arms,
    n_participants
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    evidence_support = case_when(
      n_studies == 1 ~ "Single study",
      n_studies == 2 ~ "Very limited",
      n_studies <= 4 ~ "Limited",
      n_studies >= 5 ~ "Broader evidence"
    )
  )



support_trt_tug <- summarise_trt_support(
  pf_tug,
  "Functional mobility (TUG)"
)

support_trt_chair <- summarise_trt_support(
  pf_chair_stand,
  "Lower-limb functional strength"
)

support_trt_gait <- summarise_trt_support(
  pf_vmarcha,
  "Gait speed"
)

support_trt_balance <- summarise_trt_support(
  pf_balance,
  "Balance"
)



support_trt_all <- bind_rows(
  support_trt_tug,
  support_trt_chair,
  support_trt_gait,
  support_trt_balance
) %>%
  select(
    outcome,
    trt,
    n_studies,
    n_arms,
    n_participants
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    evidence_support = case_when(
      n_studies == 1 ~ "Single study",
      n_studies == 2 ~ "Very limited",
      n_studies <= 4 ~ "Limited",
      n_studies >= 5 ~ "Broader evidence"
    )
  )

    align = "left",
    part = "body"
  ) %>%
  autofit()



doc <- read_docx()

doc <- doc %>%

  body_add_par(
    "Evidence support for physical-function outcomes",
    style = "heading 1"
  ) %>%

  body_add_par(
    "Evidence support by broad exercise category",
    style = "heading 2"
  ) %>%

  body_add_flextable(
    ft_agent
  ) %>%

  body_add_par(
    "",
    style = "Normal"
  ) %>%

  body_add_par(
    "Evidence support by specific treatment",
    style = "heading 2"
  ) %>%

  body_add_flextable(
    ft_trt
  )



output_file <- file.path(
  path.expand("~/Desktop"),
  "Physical_function_evidence_support.docx"
)

print(
  doc,
  target = output_file
)



cat(
  "\nWord file saved at:\n",
  output_file,
  "\n\n"
)

cat(
  "File exists: ",
  file.exists(output_file),
  "\n"
)

```
